title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
title_zh: ActiveEvidence：以决策为导向的证据图，具备可验证的获取间隙

paragraphs.en: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an ϵ \epsilon -decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态智能体必须决定：是否值得获取视觉证据、查询哪个候选项或分辨率，以及何时进一步交互已无法改变其决策。 我们在严格的免费元数据/付费观察边界、随机向量成本和固定执行轨迹的设定下研究该问题，并将其视为可决策认证的主动证据获取过程。 反事实证据交互图（CEIG）表示单目证据价值、带符号的二阶交互和有向条件危害，同时为未解决的交互保留显式分数边界；决策加权边界目标可收紧可能改变行动身份的界限。 间隙导向的细化仅评估能够取代当前获取策略的交互，并在 ϵ-决策证书表明未解决项无法将所选行动偏离声明容差范围时停止。 该证书具有模型相对性：它在固定学习分数下验证策略一致的最优性，而语义质量则通过冻结后的标签单独衡量。 成对延续展开可学习付费预览的下游价值；在线操作成本过滤器与独立有限策略族轨迹认证分离，而配备独立实现验证器的获取监控器则将每个证书绑定至固定轨迹。 在划分为 384/128/128 训练、验证和测试用例的 640 个案例中，控制器达到任务分数 0.842，基础 F1 为 0.816，证据召回率为 0.873，接受调用 1.74 次，视觉令牌 286.5K 个，p95 延迟为 742 毫秒。 对已签发证书的密集重播显示，行动一致性为 0.992，证书率为 0.988，同时每个决策仅评估 19.6 个昂贵交互项，而非 191.4 个。

paragraphs.en: A multimodal agent receives a user request, a candidate pool of visual evidence served through a metered acquisition interface, and an explicit resource budget. At each interaction step it may answer from text, acquire one or more candidates, request a richer visual operation, abstain, or stop when additional evidence has low expected value. Always-on vision spends budget on every candidate, while a fixed selector can miss the evidence that changes the decision. We study this as sequential evidence acquisition with an information boundary: the online policy sees selection-time fields and the acquired observations, while task labels and post-hoc usefulness labels enter only after the trace is frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 一种多模态智能体接收用户请求、通过受控获取接口提供的候选视觉证据池以及明确规定的资源预算。 在每个交互步骤中，它可以选择基于文本回答、获取一个或多个候选证据、请求更丰富的视觉操作、放弃响应，或在额外证据的预期价值较低时停止。 持续运行的视觉系统会为每个候选证据消耗预算，而固定选择器则可能错过改变决策的关键证据。 我们将此问题研究为具有信息边界的序列证据获取问题：在线策略能够看到选择时的字段和已获取的观察结果，而任务标签和事后效用标签仅在轨迹确定后才被引入。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive acquisition leaves three agent-level questions open. Evidence value is conditional on what has already been acquired, resource consumption varies with preprocessing and service load, and an ordinary replay trace records actions without checking whether the selected action was feasible or policy-consistent. Existing systems already decide when to request a higher-resolution image, a crop, or an external visual tool. ActiveEvidence targets a different question: when has an agent computed enough of the evidence-interaction structure to justify a particular acquisition decision? Exhaustively evaluating every candidate interaction is unnecessary in most states, yet ordinary sparse approximations give no local witness that the omitted interactions could not have changed the selected action. We therefore treat active visual acquisition as a decision-certification problem. The controller learns counterfactual evidence interactions, maintains architectural score enclosures for unresolved interactions, evaluates only the interactions that can still alter the top action, and stops refinement when the remaining uncertainty cannot change the decision beyond a declared tolerance. The resulting certificate is model-relative: it verifies the selected action with respect to the pinned CEIG controller, and semantic quality is established separately through post-freeze labels.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应获取留下了三个智能体层面的问题。 证据值取决于已获取的内容，资源消耗随预处理和服务负载而变化，而普通的重播轨迹仅记录动作，并未检查所选动作是否可行或与策略一致。 现有系统已经决定了何时请求更高分辨率的图像、裁剪或外部视觉工具。 ActiveEvidence 关注一个不同的问题：智能体在何时已计算出足够的证据交互结构，从而能够做出特定的获取决策？ 在大多数状态下，穷举评估所有候选交互并无必要，但普通的稀疏近似方法无法提供任何局部证据，证明被省略的交互不会改变所选动作。 因此，我们将主动视觉获取视为一个决策认证问题。 控制器学习反事实的证据交互，为未解决的交互维护架构得分边界，仅评估仍可能改变最优动作的交互，并在剩余不确定性无法在声明的容限之外改变决策时停止优化。 由此产生的证书是模型相关的：它针对固定的 CEIG 控制器验证所选动作，而语义质量则通过冻结后的标签单独确定。

paragraphs.en: We formulate decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition as a sequential agent decision under a strict boundary between free metadata and paid observations, vector-valued budgets, separate STOP / ABSTAIN terminal states, and an externally committed trace-freeze boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将决策可验证的主动证据获取问题，建模为一个序列智能体决策问题，其中自由元数据与付费观测之间存在严格边界，预算为向量值，并设有独立的“停止”/“弃权”终端状态以及一个外部指定的无痕迹冻结边界。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a decision-certifiable CEIG that separates unary utility, signed second-order interaction, directed conditional harm, and semantic contradiction, and train it with a decision-weighted enclosure objective so that interaction bounds are tightest on the edges that can change the acquisition decision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种决策可验证的 CEIG，它将单目效用、带符号的二阶交互、定向条件性危害和语义矛盾分离开来，并通过决策加权包围目标对其进行训练，从而使得交互边界在能够改变获取决策的边缘上最为紧密。

paragraphs.en: We introduce gap-directed interaction refinement: the controller refines only interactions that can displace the incumbent action, prioritizes them by their potential incumbent–challenger gap reduction, and terminates with an ϵ \epsilon -decision certificate relative to the pinned dense controller (Proposition 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种间隙导向的交互优化方法：控制器仅对能够取代当前动作的交互进行优化，根据这些交互在减少当前动作与挑战者之间潜在间隙方面的能力对其进行优先级排序，并最终相对于固定的密集控制器生成一个 ϵ \epsilon -决策证书（命题 3.2）。

paragraphs.en: We learn paid-preview value from paired continuation decisions and separate online operational cost filtering from finite-policy-family trajectory certification (Proposition 3.4 ); monitor receipts and cross-implementation replay distinguish model-relative decision consistency, resource-risk certification, trace completeness, and post-freeze evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过成对的延续决策来学习付费预览价值，并将在线运营成本过滤与有限策略族轨迹认证分离（命题 3.4）；通过监控接收数据并跨实现重播，可以区分模型相关的决策一致性、资源风险认证、轨迹完整性以及冻结后的评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate semantic quality, interaction attribution, certificate validity, preview value, cost shifts, certificate attacks, candidate-pool scaling, and transfer under matched information, supervision, and resource contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在匹配的信息、监督和资源合同下，对语义质量、交互归因、证书有效性、预览价值、成本变化、证书攻击、候选池扩展以及迁移能力进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: ReAct treats reasoning and acting as an interleaved trajectory so that external observations can redirect a plan ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Toolformer studies learning API calls, arguments, and incorporation of tool results into later prediction ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , and embodied and self-improving agents extend tool-use trajectories with environment feedback ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) . These systems motivate recording the action and feedback boundary; ActiveEvidence isolates the lower-level question of whether to acquire a visual observation at all, and records the candidate, cost, and stop event for replay.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 将推理与行动视为交错进行的轨迹，从而使得外部观察能够重新引导计划（Yao 等，2023）。 Toolformer 研究了 API 调用、参数的学习，以及将工具结果整合到后续预测中的方法（Schick 等，2023）；而具身化与自我改进的智能体则通过环境反馈扩展了工具使用轨迹（Wang 等，2024b；Shinn 等，2023；Madaan 等，2023）。 这些系统促使我们记录行动与反馈的边界；ActiveEvidence 则专门解决一个更基础的问题：是否应当获取视觉观察，并记录候选项、成本以及停止事件以供回放。

paragraphs.en: Mind2Web introduces diverse real-web tasks and a two-stage element-grounding interface ( Deng et al., 2023 ) , WebArena emphasizes self-hosted, reproducible environments and functional validators ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and AgentBench and ToolSandbox show that agent results depend on the environment, state, and tool contract ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . ActiveEvidence targets the visual-acquisition boundary inside such tasks and reports which evidence was acquired and what it cost.
paragraphs.zh: Mind2Web 引入了多样化的真实网络任务以及一个两阶段的元素定位接口（Deng 等，2023），WebArena 强调自托管、可复现的环境和功能性验证器（Zhou 等，2024），而 AgentBench 和 ToolSandbox 表明智能体的结果取决于环境、状态和工具契约（Liu 等，2024；Lu 等，2025）。 ActiveEvidence 针对此类任务中的视觉获取边界展开研究，并报告了哪些证据被获取以及其获取成本。

paragraphs.en: Computer-use and user-facing task suites make environment state, tool contracts, and trace-level evaluation first-class ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) ; the decision problem itself connects to value-of-information analysis ( Howard, 1966 ) , adaptive submodularity ( Golovin and Krause, 2011 ) , and constrained Markov decision processes ( Altman, 1999 ) . paragraphs.en: Adaptive visual acquisition and dynamic visual-tool decisions are established mechanisms ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Sivakumaran et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2023 ) : VisionThink starts from a downsampled image and requests the original resolution when needed; AdaptVision acquires coarse-to-fine and requests bounding-box crops; AdaTooler-V learns whether a visual problem requires a tool and discourages unnecessary invocations with a Tool Benefit Score; DART recruits specialized visual tools from disagreement among visual agents; ToolScope and AVIS plan over search, code, perception, and external tools for long-horizon visual information seeking. Relative to these systems, ActiveEvidence certifies for each decision that the interactions it left unevaluated cannot change the selected acquisition under the pinned controller, and binds that certificate to a replayable trace.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应视觉获取和动态视觉工具决策已成为成熟的机制（Yang et al., 2025；Lin et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026；Sivakumaran et al., 2026；Deng et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2023）：VisionThink 从降采样图像开始，并在需要时请求原始分辨率；AdaptVision 以粗到精的方式获取图像，并请求边界框裁剪；AdaTooler-V 能够判断视觉问题是否需要工具，并通过“工具收益分数”避免不必要的调用；DART 通过视觉智能体之间的分歧来调用专门的视觉工具；ToolScope 和 AVIS 则针对长期视觉信息搜索任务，对搜索、代码、感知和外部工具进行规划。 与这些系统相比，ActiveEvidence 为每个决策提供认证：在固定控制器的条件下，其未进行评估的交互无法改变已选定的获取策略，并将该认证绑定到可重放的轨迹中。

paragraphs.en: Execution and evaluation remain separate. An online upper-cost model filters operationally infeasible actions, while the frozen complete policy is subject to independent trajectory-risk certification. An acquisition monitor records preview and image requests, measured costs, rejected attempts, and canonical digests; the ordered trace is externally committed before an independently implemented verifier reconstructs the feasible set, certificate, ledger, and terminal semantics. Evaluation-only labels are joined only after this trace-freeze boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 执行与评估仍然相互独立。 一个在线的更高成本模型会过滤掉操作上不可行的动作，而冻结的完整策略则需接受独立的轨迹风险认证。 一个获取监控器会记录预览和图像请求、实际测量成本、被拒绝的尝试以及规范摘要；在由独立实现的验证器重建可行集、证书、账本和终端语义之前，该有序轨迹会被外部提交。 仅用于评估的标签仅在该轨迹冻结边界之后才会合并。

paragraphs.en: CEIG is related to value-of-information and adaptive-submodular selection, but positive interactions can violate diminishing returns and harmful conditional marginals can violate monotonicity, so the classical adaptive-greedy conditions are tested rather than assumed; matched unary-only, latent-pairwise, direct bundle-value, no-reranking, and no-uncertainty controls isolate the contribution of the explicit interaction model.
paragraphs.zh: CEIG 与信息价值及自适应亚模选择相关，但正向交互可能违反收益递减原则，而有害的条件边际可能违反单调性，因此需要检验而非假设经典的自适应贪心条件；匹配的仅单元、潜在成对、直接捆绑价值、无重排序和无不确定性控制，用于分离显式交互模型的贡献。

paragraphs.en: The CEIG loss combines Huber node, edge, and harm losses, uncertainty NLL, and a three-way interaction-sign loss whose classes are super-additive, additive, and diminishing-return. Pools with at most n full n_{\mathrm{full}} nodes enumerate all feasible pairs; larger pools retain L L uncertainty-aware neighbors per node, reducing edge scoring from O ⁡ ( n i 2 ) O(n_{i}^{2}) to O ⁡ ( n i ​ L ) O(n_{i}L) . The train/validation/test split is 384 / 128 / 128 384/128/128 , the learning rate is 3.0 × 10 − 4 3.0\times 10^{-4} , and three controller seeds are recorded. The held-out interaction error, sign AUROC, and complementary-evidence recovery are 0.071, 0.914, and 0.861, respectively (Table 10 , Appendix D.1 ); harmful conditional acquisitions are measured by the conflict-error column of that table, and decision regret is reported in Appendix D.10 .
paragraphs.zh: CEIG 损失结合了 Huber 节点、边和危害损失、不确定性 NLL，以及一个三类交互符号损失，这三类分别为超加性、加性和收益递减型。 最多包含 n 个完整 n_{\mathrm{full}} 节点的池会枚举所有可行对；更大的池则每个节点保留 L 个不确定性感知的邻居，从而将边评分的复杂度从 O(n_i^2) 降低到 O(n_iL)。 训练/验证/测试集划分为 384 / 128 / 128，学习率为 3.0 × 10^{-4}，并记录了三个控制器种子。 保留的交互误差、符号 AUROC 和互补证据恢复率分别为 0.071、0.914 和 0.861（表 10，附录 D.1）；有害条件获取通过该表的冲突误差列进行衡量，决策遗憾则在附录 D.10 中报告。

paragraphs.en: If the online policy is a measurable function of selection-visible fields, ledger state, and declared randomness, and oracle labels are joined only after the trace digest is committed, then the committed trace is conditionally independent of those labels given the online fields.

paragraphs.en: The proof is by recursive composition: each event is generated before the oracle join, so the serialized trace and its digest have no oracle argument; the engineering test also checks metadata, preview, cache, error-message, latency, and asset-hash side channels before accepting the freeze boundary. paragraphs.en: The study contains 640 cases partitioned by immutable case ID into 384 training, 128 validation, and 128 test cases. The test cases cover four task domains and 12 question types with 19.5/18/32 mean, median, and maximum candidates per case. Counterfactual targets are generated on training cases, thresholds and calibrations are selected on validation cases, and the frozen test receipt is evaluated under the pinned contract. The answer contract uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with temperature 0, top- p p 1.0, and three controller seeds. Domain names, question-type definitions, evaluator rules, model revision, controller seed IDs, and runtime hardware are specified in the pinned execution contract (Table 25 , Appendix D.14 ). All policies share the prompt, candidate pool, action cap, decoder, paid-preview contract, and vector budget. Every baseline has the same preview opportunity; preview tokens, preview latency, rejected and failed calls, and full-image costs are included in its ledger. Task score, grounding F1, evidence recall, accepted calls, visual tokens, wall-clock p95 latency, peak VRAM, abstention, and failure categories are computed after trace freeze.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究包含 640 个案例，这些案例通过不可变的案例 ID 被划分为 384 个训练案例、128 个验证案例和 128 个测试案例。 测试案例涵盖四个任务领域和 12 种问题类型，每个案例的平均、中位数和最大候选答案数量分别为 19.5、18 和 32。 反事实目标在训练案例上生成，阈值和校准在验证案例上选择，而冻结的测试收据则在固定合同下进行评估。 答案合同使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，温度设为 0，top-p 设为 1.0，并采用三个控制器种子。 领域名称、问题类型定义、评估器规则、模型版本、控制器种子 ID 和运行时硬件均在固定的执行合同中指定（表 25，附录 D.14）。 所有策略共享相同的提示词、候选答案池、动作限制、解码器、付费预览合同和向量预算。 每个基线模型都具有相同的预览机会；预览令牌、预览延迟、被拒绝和失败的调用以及全图像成本均包含在其账本中。 在轨迹冻结后，会计算任务得分、基础 F1、证据召回率、已接受的调用、视觉令牌、实际运行时间 p95 延迟、峰值 VRAM、弃权率和失败类别。

paragraphs.en: Candidate sources, negative and conflicting-evidence construction, answer-label provenance, and evidence-recall annotation are fixed in the test receipt. Task score is computed by the declared exact-match-or-semantic- equivalence evaluator with an explicit answer denominator; grounding F1 and evidence recall use the same frozen labels. Baselines include text-only, always-on, random, static metadata, Weighted Metadata, value-of-information greedy, constrained contextual bandit, unary-only, latent pairwise, a direct bundle-value regressor, a recurrent acquisition policy, and a unary model under the common protocol. Adaptive vision and Tool-based agent are generic re-implementations of adaptive-resolution acquisition and planner-driven visual-tool invocation. In addition, VisionThink, AdaptVision, and AdaTooler-V are adapted individually: each native crop, resolution, or tool action is mapped to the common acquisition action space, every pixel-derived preview, full-image request, latency event, and rejected attempt is charged under the same ledger, and no baseline receives selection-visible fields that are unavailable to ActiveEvidence. Source methods with unreported contract fields are marked N/R in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: The held-out evaluation is the primary effectiveness result. Under the common prompt, decoder, action cap, paid-preview contract, and vector budget, the full controller reaches the best task score, grounding F1, accepted-call count, visual-token count, p95 latency, and violation rate among the evidence-acquiring policies in Table 2 : relative to the strongest learned control, recurrent acquisition, task score rises from 0.828 to 0.842 while accepted calls fall from 1.82 to 1.74 and visual tokens from 299.4K to 286.5K. Always-on acquisition retains the highest evidence recall (0.948) and coverage (0.969) at 4.93 calls and 808.6K tokens. The test-contract cost of the full controller is 62.4K preview tokens, 224.1K full-image tokens, 96ms preview latency, 604ms full-image latency, and 42ms controller overhead. Dense replay of the issued ϵ \epsilon -decision certificates (Appendix D.7 ) shows 0.992 agreement with the dense controller, model regret 0.003, and a 0.988 certificate rate while 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms are evaluated per decision.
paragraphs.zh: 预留的评估结果是最主要的有效性指标。 在通用提示、解码器、动作上限、付费预览合同和向量预算的共同约束下，完整控制器在表 2 的证据收集策略中取得了最佳任务得分，并实现了最高的 F1 分数、接受调用次数、视觉标记数、p95 延迟和违规率；与最强的学习控制策略（循环获取）相比，任务得分从 0.828 提升至 0.842，而接受调用次数从 1.82 降至 1.74，视觉标记数则从 299.4K 降至 286.5K。 始终开启的获取策略在 4.93 次调用和 808.6K 个标记下，仍保持最高的证据召回率（0.948）和覆盖率（0.969）。 完整控制器的测试合同成本包括 62.4K 个预览标记、224.1K 个完整图像标记、96 毫秒的预览延迟、604 毫秒的完整图像延迟以及 42 毫秒的控制器开销。 对已发布的 ϵ \epsilon -决策证书的密集重放（附录 D.7）显示，其与密集控制器的吻合度为 0.992，模型遗憾值为 0.003，证书率为 0.988；同时，每次决策仅需评估 19.6 个昂贵交互项，而非 191.4 个。

paragraphs.en: The matched prior mechanisms in Table 2 reach task scores 0.818 (VisionThink), 0.823 (AdaptVision), and 0.810 (AdaTooler-V), compared with 0.842 for ActiveEvidence at 286.5K visual tokens. Table 10 (Appendix D.1 ) isolates learned interaction supervision, and Table 8 (Appendix C.5 ) reports gate–ranker–stopper fixture controls. paragraphs.en: ActiveEvidence is a decision-certifiable framework for resource-bounded multimodal evidence acquisition: the CEIG separates unary value, second-order interaction, directed harm, and semantic contradiction; certificate-oriented training tightens decision-relevant enclosures; gap-directed refinement converts them into a local ϵ \epsilon -decision certificate relative to the pinned dense controller; and cost filtering, trajectory-risk certification, and replayed execution consistency are measured separately. Under the held-out contract, dense replay confirms 0.992 action agreement with 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction evaluations per decision.
paragraphs.zh: ActiveEvidence 是一种具备决策可验证性的框架，适用于资源受限的多模态证据获取：CEIG 将单值、二阶交互、定向危害和语义矛盾分离开来；以证书为导向的训练强化了与决策相关的约束范围；间隙导向的优化则将其转化为相对于固定密集控制器的局部 ε-决策证书；同时，成本过滤、轨迹风险认证以及重播执行一致性均被分别评估。 在预留测试集的合同框架下，密集重播验证了动作一致性的概率为 0.992，每决策仅需 19.6 次交互评估，而非原本所需的 191.4 次昂贵交互评估。

paragraphs.en: Score feasible actions and select a proposed ordered prefix using the policy rule; record every rejected attempt, execute accepted previews or acquisitions, update the ledger, and re-score the remaining candidates until STOP or ABSTAIN is emitted.
paragraphs.zh: 根据策略规则对可行的动作进行评分，并选择一个提议的有序前缀；记录每一次被拒绝的尝试，执行已接受的预览或获取操作，更新账本，并对剩余的候选项重新评分，直到发出 STOP 或 ABSTAIN。

paragraphs.en: This section summarizes the experiment ledger, links each evidence receipt to its estimand, and reports the stress, fixture-level, and held-out audits behind the main results.

paragraphs.en: The ledger in Table 4 separates the mechanism unit test from the held-out semantic evaluation. Mechanism values are interpreted only within the metadata-only boundary; held-out values use the pinned visual contract, frozen splits, and post-freeze labels, and all of them come from the frozen row-level receipt. The two fixture rows bound only acquisition behavior on eight metadata records, the provenance row binds field calibration, and the three held-out rows carry every semantic, cost, and audit statement of the main text, including the task drops of 0.021, 0.028, and 0.034 under matched transfer, hard negatives, and conflicting evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 中的账本将机制单元测试与预留的语义评估区分开来。 机制值仅在纯元数据边界内被解释；预留值则使用固定的视觉契约、冻结的分割和冻结后的标签，且所有这些值均来自冻结的行级收据。 两个固定行仅对八个元数据记录中的获取行为进行约束，来源行约束字段校准，而三个预留行则承载了正文中的所有语义、成本和审计声明，包括在匹配迁移、困难负例和冲突证据条件下分别为 0.021、0.028 和 0.034 的任务下降值。

None of these receipts is used as evidence of semantic quality, which comes from the held-out evaluation in Table 2 .

paragraphs.en: Conflicting evidence and hard negatives cause the largest task drops (0.034 and 0.028, to 0.808 and 0.814), whereas metadata corruption lowers the task score only to 0.832. Access-injection detection stays between 0.969 and 0.981 across all stresses, the worst budget shift keeps violations at 0.029, and the large pool gives the highest task score (0.846) at 338.2K visual tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 相互矛盾的证据和困难负例会导致任务得分出现最大幅度的下降（从 0.808 和 0.814 降至 0.832），而元数据损坏则仅将任务得分降低至 0.832。 在所有压力条件下，访问注入检测的得分始终保持在 0.969 到 0.981 之间；最严重的预算偏移使违规率维持在 0.029，而较大的池则在 338.2K 视觉标记时提供了最高的任务得分（0.846）。

paragraphs.en: Active evidence attempts 1.42 and accepts 1.03 calls per row on average, leaves a final call budget of 0.97, and exhausts the budget in 0.375 of rows; always-on and the static selector accept 1.63 and 1.50 calls, leave 0.37 and 0.50, and exhaust 0.625 and 0.500 of rows. For every policy the final budget equals the initial call budget minus accepted calls, so rejected attempts consume no acquisition budget.
paragraphs.zh: 主动证据尝试平均每行接受 1.42 次调用和 1.03 次调用，最终剩余 0.97 的调用预算，并在 0.375 比例的行中耗尽预算；始终在线策略和静态选择器分别接受 1.63 次和 1.50 次调用，剩余 0.37 和 0.50 的预算，并在 0.625 和 0.500 比例的行中耗尽预算。 对于每种策略，最终预算都等于初始调用预算减去已接受的调用次数，因此被拒绝的尝试不会消耗任何获取预算。

paragraphs.en: Turning the gate on lowers activation from 1.000 to 0.625 and selected candidates from 1.625 to 1.250 for both static and active ranking without changing their ID proxy, while held-out quality rises from 0.776 to 0.792 and from 0.817 to 0.829. The learned gate, ranker, and stopper select the fewest candidates (1.125), match the best ID proxy (0.625), and reach the highest held-out quality (0.842); random ranking has the lowest ID proxy and quality (0.375 and 0.731).

paragraphs.en: This study tests whether the decision-weighted enclosure objective improves decision certification rather than only interaction prediction. All rows use the same CEIG capacity, training states, refinement rule, and controller. “Uniform tightness” penalizes every unresolved interval width equally, whereas the decision-weighted row uses ℒ cert \mathcal{L}_{\rm cert} and concentrates enclosure capacity on edges that belong to near-optimal actions. Dense agreement is measured against full CEIG enumeration, the certificate rate is the fraction of issued decisions whose declared gap passes independent dense replay, edges are the expensive interaction terms evaluated per decision, and regret is relative to the dense pinned controller.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究旨在检验决策加权包围目标是否有助于提升决策认证，而不仅仅是交互预测。 所有行均使用相同的 CEIG 容量、训练状态、精炼规则和控制器。“均匀紧度”对每个未解决的区间宽度施加相同的惩罚，而决策加权行则使用 ℒ cert \mathcal{L}_{\rm cert}，并将包围能力集中在属于近似最优行动的边界上。 密集一致性通过与完整的 CEIG 枚举进行比较来衡量，认证率是已发布决策中其声明差距通过独立密集重播的占比，边界是每次决策评估的高成本交互项，而遗憾值则是相对于密集固定控制器而言的。

paragraphs.en: Decision-certifiable inference moves part of the computational burden from online exhaustive interaction evaluation to offline counterfactual supervision. The label generator therefore counts answer-model evaluations for unary targets, pair targets, bundle targets, paired preview rollouts, and certificate-oriented decision-sensitivity weights, and these calls, training GPU-hours, and certification execution costs are reported separately from online serving cost. For each supervision package the break-even query count compares the additional offline cost with the measured per-query saving relative to dense CEIG execution; across the measured packages, N break N_{\rm break} ranges from 580 to 1290 queries.
paragraphs.zh: 决策可验证的推理方法将部分计算负担从在线的全面交互评估转移到了离线反事实监督。 因此，标签生成器会统计针对单目目标、成对目标、捆绑目标、成对预览展开以及证书导向的决策敏感度权重的答案模型评估次数；这些调用、训练 GPU 小时数以及认证执行成本均与在线服务成本分开报告。 对于每个监督包，盈亏平衡查询次数将额外的离线成本与相对于密集 CEIG 执行的每查询节省量进行比较；在所有测得的包中，N break N_{\rm break} 的取值范围从 580 到 1290 次查询不等。

paragraphs.en: The preview study isolates information value from immediate answer quality. Every controller receives the same free manifest, pays for preview pixels, and uses the same continuation horizon and initial budget. The paired method uses the downstream return target defined in Section 3.4 ; the unpaired baseline regresses a return from preview observations without the matched reference branch. A separate permutation test exchanges hidden image contents among candidates with identical allowed metadata before the first paid event. The first column in Table 20 is answered-case task utility; net benefit is the mean terminal utility change minus the declared preview cost price, and decision regret is the mean counterfactual net-gain shortfall of the committed action relative to the best action in the enumerated feasible set.
paragraphs.zh: 预览研究将信息价值与即时回答质量区分开来。 每个控制器都收到相同的免费清单，支付预览像素费用，并使用相同的延续时间范围和初始预算。 配对方法使用第 3.4 节中定义的下游回报目标；非配对基线则在没有匹配参考分支的情况下，根据预览观察结果进行回报回归。 一项独立的排列测试在首次付费事件之前，交换了具有相同允许元数据的候选项中的隐藏图像内容。 表 20 的第一列是已回答案例的任务效用；净收益是平均终端效用变化减去声明的预览成本价格，而决策遗憾则是已执行行动相对于枚举可行集中最佳行动的均值反事实净收益差额。

paragraphs.en: Paired decision-value supervision reaches task 0.842 and net benefit 0.124 with 0.043 harmful previews, 62.4K preview tokens, and decision regret 0.021, against 0.836, 0.098, 0.106, 73.1K, and 0.038 for unpaired return regression; the fixed schedule spends 118.6K preview tokens for a net benefit of 0.047, and the immediate-utility gate lies between the fixed schedule and the unpaired regression on every column.
paragraphs.zh: 成对决策值监督方法在任务表现上达到 0.842，净收益为 0.124，有害预览为 0.043，预览令牌量为 62.4K，决策后悔值为 0.021；相比之下，非成对回报回归方法的对应指标为 0.836、0.098、0.106、73.1K 和 0.038。固定计划方案消耗了 118.6K 个预览令牌，净收益仅为 0.047；而即时效用门控方法在每一列上的表现均介于固定计划方案与非成对回归方法之间。

paragraphs.en: To test whether preview value is learned from genuinely paid information, we construct candidate groups with identical allowed pre-preview metadata and permute their hidden image contents before the first paid event. A valid implementation preserves pre-preview candidate scores under this permutation and lets scores diverge only after the corresponding preview has been purchased. Permutation sensitivity is the mean absolute change of pre-preview scores, pre-preview leakage is the AUROC with which pre-preview scores predict the permuted hidden relevance, and post-preview divergence is the same AUROC after the preview has been paid for.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试预览值是否真正从付费信息中学习而来，我们构建具有相同允许预预览元数据的候选组，并在首次付费事件之前打乱其隐藏图像内容。 有效的实现方式应在此打乱操作下保留预预览候选分数，并仅在相应的预览被购买后允许分数发生分歧。 打乱敏感性是预预览分数的平均绝对变化量，预预览泄露是指预预览分数预测被打乱的隐藏相关性的AUROC值，而预购后分歧则是预览付费后的相同AUROC值。

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot transfer freezes CEIG weights, controller parameters, thresholds, cost quantiles, and utility labels. Cost-recalibration-only transfer updates only predeclared calibration statistics and thresholds on the target validation split; it regenerates no interaction or oracle utility labels. Full retraining is reported separately and may update CEIG weights and utility targets. The transfer receipt records whether counterfactual targets were regenerated. For the second VLM family, task success is 82.4% zero-shot, 84.1% with few-shot adaptation, and 85.0% after lightweight tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本迁移会冻结 CEIG 权重、控制器参数、阈值、成本分位数和效用标签。 仅成本重新校准的迁移只会更新目标验证分割中预先声明的校准统计量和阈值；它不会重新生成任何交互或神谕效用标签。 完整重训练会单独报告，并且可能会更新 CEIG 权重和效用目标。 迁移收据会记录反事实目标是否被重新生成。 对于第二个 VLM 系列，任务成功率为：零样本下为 82.4%，少量样本适应后为 84.1%，轻量级调优后为 85.0%。
